summary: IN8bio, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose entering into a Capital on Demand Sales Agreement with JonesTrading Institutional Services LLC for an at-the-market (ATM) offering program. Under the agreement, IN8bio may sell shares of its common stock from time to time at its sole discretion through the Agent, with a 3% commission on gross proceeds. The sales will be made under an existing S-3 registration statement. This is a routine equity facility, not a special situation.
